pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_rec_find: In the game's store: search «%s» by name
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_rec_store: The mods are free and in the game's store — open the store and search them by name.
pax_corpinc3d_on_tip: Switch off on a weak computer — the companies stay on the map as marks.
pax_corpinc3d_help: Pax CorpInc3D puts Pax Corporations' company buildings on the 3D Earth. If the game lags, pick a lighter mode: «Economy» keeps only the biggest companies' headquarters, no shadows, hidden when the camera is far; «Off» removes 3D entirely. «Custom» — your own options below. «Lower by itself» drops the mode a step when FPS stays below the threshold.
pax_corpinc3d_needs: Needs the Pax Corporations mod: the 3D buildings stand on its companies' sites.
pax_corpinc3d_where: Close the map and zoom in to the Earth — the buildings appear on the surface.
pax_corpinc3d_rec_corporations: Living corporations: thousands of real companies, a stock market, state stakes, zones and unions. This mod shows their sites and headquarters in 3D.
pax_corpinc3d_rec_corpface: A new interface: the header, the state card, the resource panel, clear «State» and «Relations» windows.
pax_corpinc3d_rec_corptimizer: Smoothness from real measurements: map redraws, an FPS cap, a time-skip screen.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_1_0:
• The first version: Pax Corporations' companies stand on the map as 3D models — headquarters (no frame, silver, gold), offices, factories, warehouses. Models are photographed once and drawn as pictures, so the game is hardly loaded.
• The «3D» window: switch the buildings on or off, «?» explains how it works. Console: inc3d on|off.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_1_1: • The mouse wheel over the «What's new» window (and other mod windows) scrolls the window — the map below no longer zooms in and out.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_1_2: • A new model — the mine: the extraction sites of mining and metals companies. Oil and energy keep the old derrick for now.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_1_3: • Two views: on the usual map the buildings are photographed from above (roofs, shadows), in Pax Corpface's isometric view — from the side at an angle, in volume.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_players_tip: Everything players sent through «Contact the developer» and what became of it. Renewed with every update of the mods.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_players_sub: Bugs, wishes and ratings — and the developer's answers. Yours are marked.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_players_none: Nobody has sent anything yet. The 🐞 icon in the header (Pax Corpface) or «Report a bug» (Pax Corptimizer).
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_1_4: • A new model: the headquarters of diamond companies (world places 1–10) — a futuristic dark monolith, 280 m.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_stories_tip: Memes, screenshots and stories from players' games. Share yours!
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_stories_sub: The best players sent — renewed with the mods.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_stories_intro: Something funny or epic happened in your game? Press «Share» below: a page opens where you can attach a picture (a meme or a screenshot — Win+Shift+S) and write the story. The best appear here in the next updates.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_stories_none: Empty so far — be the first!
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_share: Share a meme or a story
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_share_tip: A page opens: a picture up to 8 MB and/or a text — the developer gets them in the Pax CorpInc group.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_2_0:
• The buildings now stand on the real 3D Earth, not on the flat map: each at its own latitude and longitude, right on the surface, as real models. Close the political map and fly low over the Earth — headquarters, offices, factories, warehouses and mines appear; from far away they hide.
• A city's buildings stand on a spiral around its point, not inside each other; the city grows with the camera's height, the proportions between buildings are real.
• Sites without their own model (labs, data centres, derricks) get an office for now.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_feed_tip: The game cannot go online by itself, so this list updates with the mods. The fresh players' messages and the developer's answers are on a page in the browser.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_2_1:
• Buildings gather into cities: all companies of one place (half a degree) stand as dense blocks almost touching, the tallest towers in the middle — like the circles on the map, only in 3D. No more buildings scattered over the sea.
• A constant size: buildings neither grow nor shrink with the zoom and always stand on the planet; flying away you see yourself leaving the Earth with its cities.
• Closing the political map turns the Earth to the place you were looking at: zoom out of the USA — and you are over America.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_2_2: • Internal: the mod's code is split into separate parts — the main file only connects them. Nothing changes in the game; new features will come faster and with fewer bugs.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_2_3:
• Internal: the mod's own data keys are now English (the game's keys are unchanged). Old saves are converted automatically on load.
• Important: update all Pax CorpInc mods together — they exchange data under the new keys.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_2_4: • The mod now keeps a journal: its messages and script errors go to the «📜 Mods journal» (Pax Corpface or Pax Corptimizer).
pax_corpinc3d_q_off_text: No 3D buildings — neither on the Earth nor on the map. For the weakest computers.
pax_corpinc3d_q_eco_text: Up to 250 buildings, headquarters only (biggest companies first), no shadows; hidden when the camera is far.
pax_corpinc3d_q_normal_text: Up to 1500 buildings — headquarters, plants, offices, warehouses, mines; no shadows.
pax_corpinc3d_q_max_text: All buildings and shadows. Needs a good graphics card.
pax_corpinc3d_o_limit_tip: Above this number buildings are not placed: headquarters stay first, then companies with the highest frames.
pax_corpinc3d_o_hq_tip: Plants, offices, warehouses and mines are not shown — one building per company.
pax_corpinc3d_o_shadows_tip: Pretty, but noticeably heavier on the graphics card.
pax_corpinc3d_o_far: Hide farther than, Earth radii (0 — never)
pax_corpinc3d_o_far_tip: When the camera is farther than this from the Earth's centre the buildings are not drawn: they cannot be seen from there anyway.
pax_corpinc3d_o_auto: Lower the mode by itself below
pax_corpinc3d_o_auto_tip: If frames per second stay below the threshold for 8 seconds (while buildings are on screen), the mode drops a step: Maximum → Normal → Economy → Off. It never raises it back by itself.
pax_corpinc3d_now: Now: %d FPS · buildings on the Earth: %d
pax_corpinc3d_auto_lowered: 3D buildings: the game lagged — the mode is lowered to «%s». Bring it back in the «3D» window.
pax_corpinc3d_whatsnew_0_2_5:
• The «3D» window is now settings: modes Off / Economy / Normal / Maximum and custom — how many buildings, headquarters only, shadows, hide when far.
• «Lower by itself»: if the game stays below the chosen FPS, the mode drops a step (with a notification).
• The window shows the current FPS and buildings on the Earth. Console: inc3d eco | normal | max | off.
